decision.scope: Finite same-dataset study. Seed bootstrap is descriptive. No automatic promotion, general capability or global novelty claim.

provenance.budget: Four receiver views per training step. IIT and Tether receive identical labelled views; extra effect/invariance arithmetic is not FLOP matched.

dataset_manifest.split_method: stratified 60/20/20 image identities before task construction

provenance.evaluation: Image-disjoint within sklearn digits; synthetic tasks and posterior interventions. All donors share training lineage.
